descriptionHtml:
要人拍板 D8 · P2 · Daniela

In Today 跨服务器午夜要不要清空；AI 最坏要等约 38 秒（UAT 说约 30 秒）；空转录行「0 lines」要不要隐藏

同一个问题的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-14/S21, TC-16/S16

思路 / Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S13 「服务器换日：按天的规则在服务器的午夜切换」 Server day change: the per-day rule switches at the server's midnight

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T1 Attendance state persists correctly per day, by server time. On the same day a mark survives a reload, navigation and other devices. The day boundary follows the server clock, not the device clock.（TFA-92587 AC 6；UAT 3.8）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Two residents marked In Today at 23:30 on server day D, one left un-marked

When Open Today's Visits at 23:59 on D and at 00:01 on D+1 (server time)

Then The per-day rule (Q3: marks cleared at the server day change, or carried over) is applied at the server's midnight. The wrong-device-clock half of 3.8 is S16

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：TFA-92587 AC 6 + UAT 3.8. Until Q3 is answered only 'switched by server time, at the server's midnight' is judged. Main stores a plain boolean and never clears it

在哪跑：本地 manual（时间 lane，脚本代人做）；测试方法 TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S13 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-09.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；要拍板的人：Daniela；Allure 状态按分诊从 unknown 改成 failed。

问题分类：要人拍板（Daniela） · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92587 ready for qa

23:30 标为 In Today 的住户过了服务器午夜还在今天名单上；每天该清空还是延续，还没定。

Residents marked In Today at 23:30 are still on Today's Visits after the server's midnight. Nobody has decided whether marks should clear each day or carry over.

依据：allure 6fbcbc44, record-only: the marks carried over (A and B still In Today). TC-09 Q3 decides clear-at-midnight vs carry-over (draft #6(b), never posted). The exact 23:59/00:01 cell was not run because there is no server-clock control. Main stores a plain inTodaysSession boolean with no day. TFA-92587 AC 6 says 'persists correctly per day (server time)'.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane manual。

测试方法：TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：manual。

UAT item: TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-09/S13

Server day change: the per-day rule switches at the server's midnight

Tickets: TFA-92587 All Residents Attendance Toggle (ready for qa)

本地新 lane manual：manual/results.json 里 status record-only → 待人看（只记录，没有判过的格子 → 待人看）。

怎么测（manual/plan.json，automatable: partly）：api spec. Mark two residents In Today with their stamps at 23:30 of the previous server day (UTC) and leave one unmarked; run snf:applyLifecycle with today's day, read In Today / snf:listCounts. Record whether the marks switched at the server day change. — Q3 (cleared at the day change or carried over) is open, so the outcome is recorded, not judged. The exact 23:59 vs 00:01 instants need a movable server clock; back-dated stamps reproduce 'marked yesterday, read today', which is the half that decides the rule.

Detail:

0/0 judged cells pass, 1 recorded, 1 NOT RUN. Not run: 23:59 on D vs 00:01 on D+1 at the exact instants (needs the server clock moved across midnight (server-clock, not built); the back-dated marks reproduce 'marked yesterday, read today'). Recorded: marks set at 23:30 on the previous server day, read after the server's midnight (Q3: cleared or carried over) = {"A":true,"B":true,"C":false,"todaysVisits":["QA Resident S13 marked A","QA Resident S13 marked B"],"counts":{"done":0,"ready":true,"today":.

人工清单（manualChecklist）：

  • 【TC-09/S13 服务器午夜那一刻（5 分钟；本地栈的服务器日 = UTC，UTC 0 点 = 东京 9:00）】
  • 1. 东京 8:50 前后：Nursing Home 里给两位 QA 住户点 In Today，第三位不点。
  • 2. 8:58：看 Today's Visits 和 Dashboard 的数字，截图。
  • 3. 9:02：刷新，再看 Today's Visits 和 Dashboard，截图。
  • 4. 记下两位的标记是被清掉还是保留（Q3 还没定，所以只记录，不判 Pass/Fail）。自动化已证实：main 上 In Today 是不带日期的布尔值，跨过任何午夜都保留。

证据：附了 3 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Moving the server day needs the aging helper and a server-clock control, both through the local stack's admin key; dev has no admin key and its server clock cannot be moved, so this stays on the local stack (when the helper exists).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
